newsitem.title: GERMANY: VW says in talks to build Passat in China.
newsitem.headline: VW says in talks to build Passat in China.

text.p: Germany's Volkswagen AG said on Tuesday that it was at the start of negotiations to build the new version of its Passat saloon car in China.
A VW spokesman said the talks were underway for a facility in Shanghai.

Germany's Manager Magazine had reported that VW, Europe's largest carmaker, was considering plans for a completion facility to assemble the Passat in China since a deal to assemble the VW Santana expires in about three years.

The magazine said management board member Martin Posth was under pressure to improve sales in the Asia-Pacific region. Sales through the end of July were up 27.1 percent at 193,141 units but below planning for 223,230 units.
VW, the Shanghai Automotive Investment Corp and the Chinese National Auto Investment Corp have been involved for 10 years in the Shanghai-Volkswagen Automotive Company to produce the Santana.
